about.title: A family company that keeps its prices down
text: Cool Maxx Mechanical is a locally owned and operated heating, air conditioning and refrigeration company, and we are family owned and operated.
Our technicians do not work on commission, which lets us keep our prices down and lets you count on honest answers that are best for you and your family's comfort.
We have the experience to work on all makes and models, and our goal is a good job at a good price so you keep doing business with us for years.
Many of our customers love to refer us to their friends and family.
